facebook.caption:
POV: you scroll past a Phu Quoc hotel listing, double back, and realize it has 1,533 reviews at 4.9 stars.

That hotel is Regent Phu Quoc.

Located in Khu Phố Đường Bào, this is the kind of property that makes people stop mid-trip planning. Nearly 1,500 guests gave it 4.9. That number is almost impossible to maintain at scale.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
